paper_id: Sun et al. - 2019 - iTracker Towards Sustained Self-Tracking in Dynamic Feature Environment with Smartphones
title: iTracker: Towards Sustained Self-Tracking in Dynamic Feature Environment with Smartphones
motivation: 现有智能手机自追踪方案在快速旋转、特征不清晰、快速移动、动态场景下会丢失追踪
problem_framing: 将自追踪失败归因于IMU延迟、特征误匹配、帧间跳变、移动特征四类场景
key_insight: 用IMU短期精确数据与SLAM结果对比检测漂移,通过Parallel-Multi-State Local Recovery自动恢复
method_signature: IMU-Orientation Calculator + Monocular-SLAM + EKF融合 + Parallel-Multi-State Local Recovery
evaluation_criteria: 方向误差、延迟时间、DTW距离、0.7%距离误差占全程比例
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 移动特征是最主要影响因素,存在cold-start问题;漂移从3m降至0.3m仍非零
evidence_for_taste: tracking would be lost in four such common scenarios
reduce the degree error by 7° and the delay by 22ms
reduce the distance drift of nearly 3m to 0.3m
average distance error is within 0.7% over 2000-meter trajectories
tracking is lost abruptly due to it mainly depends on the camera
thinking_moves: 从工程异常反推底层物理假设失效
对四类失败场景逐一诊断根因并模块化应对
用IMU短期精确性约束视觉SLAM漂移
将恢复问题转化为状态向量对齐问题
extraction_notes: 论文目录显示为2019年但未找到确切会议名称;角色基于作者顺序第五位推断为co-author;系统架构描述完整但部分算法细节因空间限制省略
